title: Fix PDF export by ensuring jsPDF library is reliably loaded

requirements.text: Make PDF export work reliably by bundling and loading the PDF libraries within the app (jsPDF and the autoTable plugin) instead of depending on global CDN scripts (window.jspdf), so users can export a generated quote to a PDF without seeing the error "PDF export library is not loaded".

quotes: PDF export library is not loaded. Please load it so that I am  able to print the quote generated to pdf

acceptanceCriteria: From the Quote Summary screen, clicking "Export PDF" downloads a PDF without throwing the error "PDF export library is not loaded".
From the Analysis tab, clicking "Export PDF" downloads a PDF without throwing the error "PDF export library is not loaded".

The PDF export implementation does not rely on window.jspdf being pre-populated by CDN scripts; it uses app-bundled imports/loading so it works in production environments where external CDNs may be blocked.
If PDF libraries still fail to load for any reason, the user sees a clear English error message indicating PDF export could not be initialized and to try again.

requirements.text: Update the HTML entry point and/or PDF export utility so there is a single, consistent source of truth for PDF library loading (avoid double-loading via both CDN scripts and bundled imports), preventing runtime mismatches where the autoTable plugin is missing.

quotes: PDF export library is not loaded. Please load it so that I am  able to print the quote generated to pdf

acceptanceCriteria: The app does not end up in a state where jsPDF is present but autoTable is missing (or vice versa) due to conflicting load paths.
No console error appears during normal page load related to jsPDF or autoTable initialization.
Existing export flows continue to work with the same user-facing button labels (e.g., "Export PDF").

constraints: Do not edit files in frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or anything under frontend/src/components/ui (compose instead).
Keep all backend logic in the single Motoko actor (backend/main.mo); no backend changes are required for this PDF loading fix.
nonGoals: Fixing the separate rate card CSV upload error (IC0508 canister stopped).
Adding branding, headers, or logos to the PDF output (unless required to make loading work).
Changing the content/layout of the generated PDFs beyond what is necessary to ensure the export libraries load and function.
